accountantMode.label: Accountant Mode
accountantMode.toggleTitle: Tap to change — an explanation appears before anything is applied
accountantMode.turnOffMessage: Accountant Mode is currently ON. Turning it off hides the accounting menus — Transaction Records (journal), Details by Account (general ledger), Chart of Accounts — and the debit/credit labels on forms, so the screen speaks everyday language only (money in / money out). This changes only YOUR view: not the data, the figures, or your access rights. You can turn it back on at any time.
accountantMode.turnOnMessage: Accountant Mode is currently OFF. Turning it on shows the accounting menus — Transaction Records (journal), Details by Account (general ledger), Chart of Accounts — and the debit/credit labels on forms. Useful if you know bookkeeping. This changes only YOUR view: not the data, the figures, or your access rights. You can turn it off again at any time.
